summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a 6-K disclosing that its Board of Directors approved, on October 9, 2026, the declaration and payment of Interest on Company's Equity (JCP, the Brazilian equivalent of a dividend) totaling R$1.5bn gross (R$1.2375bn net after withholding tax), equal to R$0.19095423791 per common share, R$0.21004966171 per preferred share and R$0.40100389962 per Unit. Record date is October 20, 2026, ex-date October 21, payment November 9, 2026. The amount counts toward 2026 mandatory dividends and is subject to shareholder ratification at the OGM by April 30, 2027. Watch ratification and future capital-return cadence.
